data.turoyo: Kito bu bayto ste kurkat maḥte. Yaʕni daste, komaḥtənne ʕal ak kurkat w bəṯr komṣanṣlənne ʕal i maṣoke w komdarmnənne bi nqurto.
data.translation: Im Hause sind mehrere kesselherdeaufgestellt, d. h. man stellt Große kesse! auf die Herde, lässt den Most durch die seihe laufen und versetzt ihn mit geriebenem weißem Stein.

rationale: Adds the strainer context, not printed in the existing 75/224 quotation despite the inherited 94/133 reference; same sense 1.

summary: Both occurrences were checked as active I Infectum with generic plural agents and a patient suffix. m- belongs to the inherited base mṣanṣəl; the forms are not Detransitive just because the stem begins with m-.
75/224 is the exact existing quotation and is not duplicated. 94/133 is already among its references, but its strainer wording is not quoted; this distinct context fills the thin sense-1 cell.
Source m-u barġal contrasts with path/tool ʕal i maṣoke. No new straining sense or idiom is needed.

Inherited senses 2 and 3 explicitly carry Detransitive labels inside the shared sense list. Their numbering and wording are preserved, although the parsed detransitiveSenses array is empty; no new Detransitive attestation occurs here.
In 94/133 what does plural -nne resume: the must collectively, liquid contents, or a preceding plural discourse referent? The German singular Most does not determine the Turoyo suffix.
Should the editors structurally separate inherited Detransitive senses 2 and 3 while keeping their labels? The present batch does not renumber or reword them.
The drained substance is grape must passing through a strainer as well as water drained from grain; ordinary draining covers both technical food-processing settings.
